record.body: Former police lieutenant from New Jersey. Director of Security at Canton-Potsdam Hospital when JD started in June 2023. Married to the hospital's Chief Nursing Officer. His leadership style — defending officers against vague complaints, using documentation as the department's defining strength, managing upward through visible metrics — made enough of an impression on JD that he wrote a formal case study on it. Resigned while JD was at BCT over a disagreement about badge-issuing duties being assigned to Security.
